grader.method: Read every answer and citation in the post-Auditor artifact, compared them with critical-bhyt-7.jsonl and the local public-source files, and evaluated only publicly named authorities and answer content. No runtime, database or release mutation was performed.

source_check.note: A source being present locally does not prove that every returned citation supports the claim. Opaque document/chunk/dataset IDs were excluded from grading.

summary.substantive_legal_correctness: PARTIAL; core rules recovered in cases 01, 02, 05 and 06, but answer completeness and source precision are inadequate
summary.claim_groundedness: PARTIAL; case 06 fully grounded, cases 01/02/05 partly grounded, cases 03/04/07 incomplete or NOT_OBSERVABLE
summary.citation_precision: LOW_OVERALL; many citation lists contain unrelated or duplicate passages
summary.citation_coverage_for_answerable_cases: 5/6 cases have at least one accepted public authority; case 07 has only a non-supporting current-law citation

citation_precision_numeric.note: Counts are strict manual counts of direct support, not an automatic metric; conditional/irrelevant citations are not credited.

summary.temporal_correctness: PARTIAL; case 01 flags old/new threshold wording, case 07 avoids a false 2005-current claim, but currentness is not established with an authoritative status citation

latency_ms.note: All requests are thematic/temporal in the artifact; the Plan targets hybrid p95 <=8s and temporal/multi-hop p95 <=15s or async. The reported p95 is effectively the maximum with n=7.

trace_fields_missing: selected source spans with stable provenance
summary.release_decision: DO_NOT_PROMOTE; improve citation selection, temporal authority handling, latency and real tracing, then rerun and obtain human legal review
